text:
Ana P: Quick heads-up — Jordan A. (new hire, Tokyo office, starts Mon 2026-04-05) flagged a remote I-9 exception. We need an in-person ID verification or an approved alternate. Can we coordinate a local drop-in/check-in slot + badge pickup and short parking permit? @Leo @Sam

Sam (IT): I can ship laptop + passcodes tomorrow. Tracking to Jordan will be UPS; will need a confirmed local pickup window for signature.

Leo (Facilities): We have a badge-drop slot at the Tokyo satellite hub between 09:00-11:30 JST Mon–Wed. I can reserve 10:15 for Jordan if that works. Parking permits require a signed access form from People Ops.

Jordan A.: 10:15 JST works for me. Thanks! I live in Saitama so will take the morning train — is there a quick AM check-in form I should pre-fill?

Ana P: Please fill the short check-in form and upload ID scans if possible before arrival. Link: https://redwood.example/hr/checkin (one-time token sent to your email). If you can’t upload, bring originals.

Mika (Buddy): I’ll meet Jordan at the reception and walk them through orientation. Mika -> pls arrive 15m early to escort. :wave:

Sam (IT): Laptop will be delivered to Facilities by 08:45 JST. I’ll leave IT asset tag + temporary WiFi creds with Leo. Sample creds: SSID=redwood-guest, PW=Welcome2026! (will change on first login).

Leo (Facilities): Reserved 10:15 slot and created parking permit form: https://redwood.example/facilities/permits/tokyo. Ana, can you confirm the signed access form?

Ana P: Confirmed — I uploaded the signed access form to the permit portal and added Jordan to the visitor list. Also opened a background-check follow-up ticket: BG-4721 — looks like one address history item needs clarification (old apartment in 2019). Jordan, HR asked for a short note explaining the gap.

Jordan A.: Happy to provide that. I’ll DM the note now and upload to the portal. Thanks for the help everyone.

hr-bot: Background check status: pending docs. Portal: https://redwood.example/hr/bg/4721 — please upload supporting doc (utility bill or rental agreement) within 72 hrs to avoid delay. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ana P: Final checklist for Monday: 1) Jordan uploads doc for BG ticket 4721; 2) Jordan fills pre-checkin form; 3) Mika escorts at 10:15; 4) Sam confirms laptop handoff; 5) Leo issues badge + parking permit. If any item slips, plan fallback: badge-on-hold + remote orientation via Zoom at 11:30 JST.

Sam (IT): noted. Will also include VPN onboarding script snippet for Jordan on the laptop desktop: 

```
# Quick VPN setup
open "redwood.app/vpn-setup"
enter temporary token sent to email
```

Mika (Buddy): I’ll set a quick 30-min intro at 11:00 JST to cover benefits links and first-day agenda. Jordan — bring a government ID to the kiosk. :thumbsup:

Jordan A.: All set — I uploaded the note to BG ticket and completed the check-in form. See you Monday 10:15. Appreciate the quick coordination! :smile:

Ana P: Thanks team — closing coordination thread. I’ll post a short calendar invite for everyone included. :calendar:
